name: sgs/nav-drawer-menu
title: SGS Nav Drawer Menu
description: The site's menu PANEL content: a vertical accordion (or JS-enhanced drill-down) list of links, rendered only inside sgs/nav-drawer. Submenus render as native <details> accordion rows one level deep (MAX_SUBMENU_DEPTH = 1). Menu content comes from a native WordPress menu, via the same one-source resolver sgs/nav-bar-menu uses. sgs/nav-bar-menu owns the flat horizontal bar.

indicator.reason: style.css declares .sgs-nav-drawer-menu__indicator { pointer-events: none; } — the element is structurally unhoverable, the browser passes all pointer events through to whatever is underneath. It paints from the item Background row's own Hover swatch (itemBgHover / itemBgHoverGradient) under itemBgHoverTreatment === 'highlight' (Spec 41 FR-41-25), so its colour already carries that row's states rather than a parallel pair of its own.

submenu-bg.reason: The submenu panel's visibility is a binary open/closed disclosure toggled by the trigger, not by pointer position over the panel itself — once open, the pointer is always over some interactive CHILD, never a hoverable moment on the panel background itself. The hoverable surface inside the panel is the LINK background, which carries its own full three-state family (submenuLinkBg / submenuLinkBgHover / submenuLinkBgCurrent, Spec 41 FR-41-9) — that is where a hover fill belongs, and it is declared there.

submenu-border.reason: The panel's border sits on the same structurally non-hoverable surface as its background, for the same reason: once the panel is open the pointer is always over an interactive CHILD. Per-state border colour inside the panel belongs to the LINK, whose own three-state family (submenuLinkBg / submenuLinkBgHover / submenuLinkBgCurrent) is where a pointer-driven change is actually perceivable. submenuBorderColour is therefore Normal-only (Spec 41 FR-41-9).

sibling-dim.reason: The row IS a pointer-driven state: its colour paints the OTHER items only while one item is hovered or keyboard-focused (a list-scoped :has() rule). There is no resting moment for it to differ from, so a separate Hover swatch would describe nothing.

ornament.reason: One ornament span holds either a counter (::before text) or an SVG glyph drawn in currentColor, per tier. The text-gradient trio sets color:transparent, which erases the SVG glyph, and an SVG stroke gradient cannot paint the counter text, so one gradient value cannot serve both modes of the same element. Structurally impossible for this element, not undecided.

wrapper.label: Nav wrapper
wrapper._note: The rendered <nav> (block-private root, no SGS_Container_Wrapper). Padding/margin ride the native spacing support; max-width is the flat attribute. navBg/navColour/navBgHover all write to the same bare $uid_sel wrapper selector. The ARRANGEMENT members (layer OUTER) — display/flex-direction/align-items/justify-content etc. — are honest GAPs: style.css hardcodes `display:block` (an always-vertical list) with no attribute behind it.
wrapper._note_hover_nav: navColourHover is routed to the wrapper element because render.php emits sgs_hover_state_rules( "{$uid_sel}", 'color:…', ':focus-visible' ) on the block ROOT, not a descendant.

bar.label: Item bar (flex row)
bar._note: The <ul class="sgs-nav-drawer-menu__bar"> that actually arranges the item links (a vertical list). Remaining ARRANGEMENT members are honest GAPs (style.css hardcodes `list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;position:relative` with no attribute). `css:grid-template-columns:count` is a pseudo-property destination tag (mirrors `css:color-gradient` — not a real CSS property, a manifest-level routing key) claiming `listColumns` as this element's grid COLUMN-COUNT destination for the converter's grid resolver (`db.attr_for_grid_column_count`), matching render.php's own target selector `.sgs-nav-drawer-menu__bar` for the in-drawer vertical-list column count.

item.label: Nav item (resting)

hover._noBaseByDesignNote: css:padding-inline-start (itemPaddingShiftHover) has no resting counterpart by design: the value is an ADDITIVE hover-only shift on top of whatever inline-start padding is already in effect at rest (style.css's `padding: 8px 12px`), not an absolute padding of its own — a 'resting shift' control would be redundant with the item's existing padding. Same shape as css:transform (scaleHover) on sgs/icon/sgs/post-grid, Bean-ruled 2026-08-20.

item._note: The nav item LINK — every stateful control on this element targets the <a>, never the <li> (Spec 41 FR-41-1). Three states are declared: base, `hover` (render.php's `$hover_targets` = `:hover, :focus-visible`) and `current` (`[aria-current="page"]`), so a visitor can distinguish WHERE THEY ARE from WHAT THEY ARE POINTING AT. The current-page state is operator-controllable through `itemColourCurrent` / `itemBgCurrent` / `itemFontWeightCurrent` (Spec 41 FR-41-1); `itemFontWeightCurrent` is the non-colour signal that satisfies WCAG 1.4.1 without relying on colour alone. `current` deliberately maps DIFFERENT attribute names from `hover`: the classifier's `extract-signatures.py::_record` is last-write-wins, so a state map byte-identical to `hover` silently overwrites the hover derivation and tags those attributes with a css_state they never render in. Every state member is EXPLICIT rather than left to the `{prefix}Suffix` convention — `css:font-weight`, `css:text-decoration` and `css:text-transform` each carry a base attribute AND a state sibling, and without an explicit entry per state both derive to the same (property, element, state=NULL) slot and collide on one routing destination. The base `css:font-weight` -> `itemFontWeight` entry is load-bearing for the same reason: a state entry with no base is the STATE_WITHOUT_BASE shape the manifest gate flags. `css:border-radius` -> `itemBorderRadius` is base-only — radius has no state on `SgsBorderControl` (Spec 41 FR-41-7). M-21 (2026-09-23): `css:opacity` -> itemOpacity/itemOpacityHover and `css:padding-inline-start` -> itemPaddingShiftHover (hover-only) added; itemPaddingShiftHover is ALSO mapped on the `sublink` element below (dropdown/accordion submenu link) — the SAME attribute reused across both elements, deliberately, because the reference sites only ever set one padding-shift value per instance; itemOpacity/itemOpacityHover are NOT reused on `sublink` because fantasy's own reference needs a genuinely DIFFERENT rest/hover opacity pair on its sub-link (0.6 to 1) from its item link (1 to 0.5).

indicator.label: Sliding indicator
indicator._note: The `.sgs-nav-drawer-menu__indicator` sliding pill, view.js-animated behind the active/hovered item. It is rendered under `itemBgHoverTreatment === 'highlight'` and paints from the item Background row's OWN Hover swatch — `itemBgHover` / `itemBgHoverGradient`, claimed by the `item` element's `states.hover` (Spec 41 FR-41-25) — so this element routes no attribute of its own: one picker, one property, three ways of applying it. `clusters: ["fill"]` is retained (not `[]`) because the forward-resolution pass only visits a cluster's members when the cluster is declared; with an empty attrMap the fill members are honest GAPs, ungated and correct, since this element has no controls of its own. `supports.sgs.colourExemptions.indicator` records why it carries no hover state: style.css declares `.sgs-nav-drawer-menu__indicator { pointer-events: none; }`, so the element is structurally unhoverable.

featured.label: Featured item
featured._note: featuredFontWeightHover is a genuine hover-state weight change (only emitted when it differs from resting), declared under `text` cluster's css:font-weight member. featuredColourGradient mirrors burgerColourGradient's shape -- explicit attrMap since css:color-gradient is not resolved by the default {prefix}Suffix convention, same reason burgerColourGradient needed one. Resting LABEL form only; PILL form and the submenu-inheritance custom property stay flat (see render.php comments). featuredBgGradient/featuredBgHoverGradient: non-empty wins over the resolved featuredBg/featuredBgHover slug+hex; when active the pill foreground skips WCAG contrast-against-background maths (no single hex to test) and uses the operator's own flat colour instead (see render.php). The submenu-inheritance custom property stays hex-only, same scope boundary as featuredColourGradient above.

sublink.label: Submenu link

hover._noBaseByDesignNote: css:padding-inline-start (itemPaddingShiftHover, M-21) has no resting counterpart by design: an ADDITIVE hover-only shift on top of the resting inline-start padding already in effect (includes/nav-menu-submenu-css.php's hardcoded `padding:0 16px`, no attribute of its own to override). Reused from the `item` element above -- see that element's own note for why the SAME attribute (not a separate submenuPaddingShiftHover) is correct here.

sublink._note: The submenu LINK — <a class="sgs-nav-drawer-menu__sublink">, painted at render.php's own scoped `.sgs-nav-drawer-menu__sublink{...}` rule. It carries three states: base, `hover` (`sgs_hover_state_rules()` on `:hover, :focus-visible`) and `current` (`[aria-current="page"]`), matching the bar item's own three-state model (Spec 41 FR-41-1 / FR-41-9). `"prefix": ""` is a deliberate, permanent opt-out from the `{prefix}Suffix` convention: a `submenu` prefix would wrongly claim submenuAlign/Caret/CloseGrace/MinWidth/Padding and the whole submenuBorder* family, which belong to the submenu PANEL (the `submenu-panel` element) rather than to this anchor. The `submenu`-prefixed typography attributes that DO belong to this anchor reach it through the explicit attrMap entries above, one per property — that is the resolution, not a prefix (Spec 41 FR-41-22c). With an empty prefix nothing here resolves by convention, so every member is explicit by necessity: each state's `css:color`, `css:background-color`, `css:font-weight`, `css:text-decoration` and `css:text-transform` names a DIFFERENT attribute from its base sibling, because without an explicit entry a base and its state sibling both derive to (property, sublink, state=NULL) and collide on one routing slot. `"fill"` is declared alongside `"text"` so the forward-resolution pass actually visits css:background-color / css:background-image and consults this attrMap; a cluster that is not declared is never iterated. submenuColourGradient is routed as a DIRECT declaration (sgs_text_colour_decl / sgs_resolve_text_colour_or_gradient) rather than a colour-valued custom property, because a `var(--x, …)` chain feeding a fixed `color:` declaration cannot switch to `background-image` for a gradient (survey.js's `paints-via-colour-valued-custom-property`  submenuOpacity/submenuOpacityHover (M-21, this task) close the fantasy reference gap left open by the item element's own opacity pair — fantasy needs the sublink resting at 0.6 opacity and brightening to 1 on hover, the OPPOSITE direction from the item's 1-to-0.5, so a genuinely separate attribute pair was required rather than reusing itemOpacity/itemOpacityHover here.

submenu-panel.label: Submenu panel
submenu-panel._note: The open accordion SECTION — <ul class="sgs-nav-drawer-menu__submenu"> — as distinct from the links inside it, which are the `sublink` element (Spec 41 FR-41-9). Base only: NO `states` key at all, because the panel has neither a hover nor a current state for any property. Its visibility is a binary open/closed disclosure toggled by the trigger; once open the pointer is always over an interactive CHILD, so a pointer-driven change on the panel surface itself is never perceivable — the hoverable surface inside the panel is the LINK background (submenuLinkBg / submenuLinkBgHover / submenuLinkBgCurrent on `sublink`). Recorded as `supports.sgs.colourExemptions.submenu-bg` and `.submenu-border`. `"prefix": ""` for the same reason `sublink` carries it: a `submenu` prefix would claim submenuColour* and the submenu typography family, which belong to the LINK. Every member is therefore explicit. submenuBorderRadius, submenuShadow and submenuShadowColour paint the section's own box (includes/nav-drawer-menu-section-css.php::sgs_nav_drawer_menu_section_box_css). submenuMinWidth is not declared here: a section is exactly as wide as the drawer, so a minimum width has nothing to protect against.

item-dimmed.label: Dimmed sibling item
item-dimmed._note: Wave 3C U-6, M-24: every OTHER item in the same list while one is hovered or keyboard-focused (a list-scoped :has() rule, includes/helpers-item-effects.php::sgs_sibling_dim_css). itemMotionDuration/itemMotionEasing are the ONE shared item-motion pair (sibling dim, label roll, ornament crossfade); explicit because the {prefix}{suffix} convention cannot derive them.

ornament.label: Row ornament
ornament._note: Wave 3C U-7, M-22: the decorative leading number or glyph (.sgs-nav-drawer-menu__ornament) before each primary row label.

expander.label: Accordion expander
expander._note: Wave 3C U-7: the <summary> expander glyph (.sgs-nav-drawer-menu__caret). itemExpanderRotate is the rotate() applied while its accordion is open; itemExpanderIcon is the glyph (icon source). submenuCaretSize, submenuCaretGap, submenuCaretOpacity, submenuCaretOpacityHover and submenuCaretTurnDuration/Easing/EasingCustom style the same glyph through includes/nav-menu-caret-css.php::sgs_nav_menu_caret_css, the helper sgs/nav-bar-menu calls for its own caret.

media.label: Item media
media._note: Wave 3C U-7, M-15/M-22: the per-item featured-image thumbnail (.sgs-nav-drawer-menu__media). itemMediaReveal is per tier: none / always / hover (grows from width 0).

item-open.label: Item text (open)
item-open._note: G-11, 2026-09-28: the label colour of a top-level accordion item while its own <details> is open. Declared as its own element, NOT as a state on `item` (same reasoning as the `disabled-item` element below): `open` is not in golden-controls.json's `_meta.stateVocabulary` (hover/current/scrolled), and it is not the same concept as `current` (page identity vs disclosure state) — conflating them would apply the wrong colour to a currently-open, not-current-page section. Painted via a `:has()` sibling-state rule keyed to the accordion's own `[open]` attribute (includes/nav-drawer-menu-extras-css.php); no JS.

badge.label: Item badge
badge._note: Parity with sgs/nav-bar-menu, 2026-09-28. The optional per-item marker chip ("SOON", "NEW") rendered after an item's label via the SHARED includes/nav-menu-markup.php::sgs_nav_shared_badge_html() call already present in sgs_nav_drawer_menu_render_items(); this block previously declared no colour attributes for it. Badge COPY is per-item (the operator's classic-menu-item Description field); badge COLOUR is block-level, one Colour-panel row applying to every badge this drawer renders. No hover state — a badge is never itself interactive.

disabled-item.label: Disabled item
disabled-item._note: Parity with sgs/nav-bar-menu, 2026-09-28. A disabled menu item renders as non-link text with aria-disabled="true". Declared as its own element, not a state on `item`, for the same stateVocabulary reason as the bar's identical row. Wired for accordion-parent rows only this pass (sgs_nav_drawer_menu_accordion_html()) — leaf/sub-item rows render through the shared nav-menu-markup.php item-list builder, out of this block's file-ownership scope for this pass; the CSS rule below targets both `__link` and `__sublink` `[aria-disabled="true"]` so it is ready the moment that render path is wired.

trailing-icon.label: Trailing icon
trailing-icon._note: G-7, 2026-09-28: a per-item trailing glyph (.sgs-nav-drawer-menu__trailing-icon) after ANY row's label, independent of the accordion expander. The glyph CHOICE is per-item (itemTrailingIcons, a map keyed by item identifier); colour and size are block-level, matching the badge/ornament split. Unset colour inherits currentColor.

mega-body.label: Mega panel body
mega-body._note: The <li class="sgs-nav-drawer-menu__mega-body"> that holds a mega item's own panel inside its drawer accordion (megaDrawerMode 'panel', Spec 36 FR-36-6). megaBodyPadding replaces the hardcoded 0 12px 12px (style.css keeps it as the unset default).

sgs._note_sweep_eligibility: The ONE declarative source for the Sweep-treatment eligibility predicate, read by BOTH surfaces — edit.js decides whether to offer the Sweep segment, render.php decides whether to emit Sweep CSS — with neither re-deriving the rule (Spec 41 FR-41-26). It is NOT an `elements` entry and routes no CSS property; it sits beside colourExemptions / hideExtensions / boxFamilies. Three keys per row: `blockingBackgroundAttrs` (Sweep is withdrawn when ANY named attribute is non-empty, because background-clip:text clips the element's whole background-painting area to the glyph shapes — every state's background counts, not just the resting one), `blockingGradientAttrs` (the row's own text gradient writes background-image on the identical selector, so whichever loses is invisible) and `glyphGuard` (background-clip:text needs glyphs to grip; null means the element always has them). Every attribute named below must exist in `attributes` — a typo reads as permanently empty, so the predicate would always pass and the rule would silently cease to exist.
sgs._note_imageControls: Opt-out: the only is the per-item media thumbnail (itemMedia), a decorative slot showing each linked page's own featured image, sized by itemMediaWidth/itemMediaHeight/itemMediaRadius and always object-fit cover. It is not an operator-placed image, so the image-controls panel (focal point, fit, filters) does not apply.

separators.description: The lines between the TOP-LEVEL rows of the drawer list (the shared Separators setting, includes/helpers-separators.php): { row: { style, width: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, colour, colourHover }, edges: between | all | end, hoverTreatment: swap | sweep | none, sweepAngle }. A horizontal line centred in the gap between stacked rows, drawn by the rows; edges end draws a line under the last row too. With listColumns on, the lines are drawn as a grid instead. No thickness (the default) draws nothing.

submenuSeparators.description: The lines between the rows of an open submenu (a dropdown panel on the bar, a nested section in the drawer): the shared Separators setting, rows only, replacing the old per-row link border. Defaults to a 1px line in the border-light token with an accent hover.

megaDrawerFallbackIds.description: Per-item opt-OUT from the mega-menu item's default plain-link degrade in the DRAWER form only. A mega-typed item authored as a core/navigation-submenu with real nested child links renders those children as an ordinary accordion/submenu list in the drawer when its identifier is listed here, instead of collapsing to a plain link. A mega item with NO nested children still degrades to a plain link regardless (nothing to list). The BAR/desktop form is completely unaffected — it keeps the full mega-panel disclosure either way. Unset (default []): every mega item degrades to a plain link in the drawer (FR-36-5 reserves the FULL mega-panel-inside-the-drawer build as future work).

megaDrawerMode.description: Wave 3C U-7 (.claude/reports/2026-09-25-u6-u7-design.md 3a; Spec 36 FR-36-6). How a mega-menu item shows in the drawer: `panel` renders its mega panel post inside its own accordion (no floating shell; text follows the drawer), `link` is a plain link. An item listed in megaDrawerFallbackIds with real nested children keeps its children accordion either way.

labelRoll.description: Wave 3C U-6, M-25 (.claude/reports/2026-09-25-u6-u7-design.md 3d). Two-copy label roll on hover or keyboard focus: '' off (no extra markup), `up` (the label rolls up to a copy of itself), `up-scale` (the outgoing copy also shrinks to 0.8). Honours reduced motion.

siblingDimColour.description: Wave 3C U-6, M-24 (.claude/reports/2026-09-25-u6-u7-design.md 3c). Text colour of the OTHER items in the same list while one is hovered or keyboard-focused. '' off.

siblingDimColourGradient.description: Gradient sibling of siblingDimColour (text-gradient trio: background-clip:text with a first-stop fallback). Non-empty wins over the flat colour.

siblingDimOpacity.description: Wave 3C U-6, M-24. Opacity (0 to 1) of the other items in the same list while one is hovered or keyboard-focused. Unset off.

itemMotionDuration.description: Wave 3C U-6 (.claude/reports/2026-09-25-u6-u7-design.md 3c). ONE item-motion time in ms (0 to 3000) shared by this block's item effects (sibling dim, label roll, the ornament crossfade). Unset resolves to 300.

itemMotionEasing.description: Item-motion easing curve, from the shared motion easing list (includes/helpers-motion-easing.php).

itemMotionEasingCustom.description: A hand-typed `cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2)` curve, read only when `itemMotionEasing` is `custom` (validated by sgs_motion_valid_cubic_bezier).

itemOrnament.description: Wave 3C U-7, M-22 (.claude/reports/2026-09-25-u6-u7-design.md 3e). Per tier ({desktop,tablet,mobile}), what leads each primary row: `none`, `index` (a decorative two-digit counter, 01, 02 …) or `icon` (itemOrnamentIcon).

itemOrnamentIcon.description: The leading glyph when itemOrnament is `icon` (IconPicker {source,name}).

itemOrnamentIconHover.description: Optional hover glyph; crossfades with itemOrnamentIcon on hover or keyboard focus.

itemOrnamentSize.description: Per tier: the glyph box, or the number's font size for `index`. Unset 0.75em.

itemOrnamentColour.description: Ornament colour; '' inherits the row's text colour.

itemOrnamentColourHover.description: Ornament colour on hover or keyboard focus.

itemOrnamentGap.description: Space between the ornament and the label. Unset 0.5em.

ornamentHiddenItemIds.description: Per-item opt-out from the leading ornament (same identifier scheme as featuredItemIds/disabledItemIds). A listed item renders no ornament glyph/counter and reserves no ornament space, matching a row that has no ornament at all. Ticked in the Settings tab's Ornament panel; has no effect when itemOrnament is none at every tier.

itemExpanderIcon.description: Wave 3C U-7, M-22 (.claude/reports/2026-09-25-u6-u7-design.md 3e). The accordion expander glyph (IconPicker {source,name}).

itemExpanderRotate.description: Degrees the expander glyph turns while its accordion is open (-360 to 360). 45 turns a plus into a cross.

itemHoverScope.description: 'all' (default): every top-level row takes the configured hover paint. 'with-submenu': only rows that open an accordion section (`.sgs-nav-drawer-menu__item--has-submenu`, `--mega`) take the hover text, background, opacity and border paint; a plain link row stays inert on hover. Read by includes/nav-menu-css.php::sgs_nav_shared_item_state_css and includes/nav-menu-item-hover-scope-css.php, the same helpers sgs/nav-bar-menu uses.

itemMagnetStrength.description: The row-label magnet's pull FACTOR, 0.02 to 0.5. No default: unset keeps magnet.js's own shipped strength (factor 0.15, an 8px cap). When set, the cap is lifted, the pointer only engages inside the label's own box. Emitted as `data-magnet-strength` on the list and read by view.js::initBarEffects. Shown only while `itemMagnetEnabled` is on; pointer-fine only (touch and reduced motion switch the effect off).

justifyContent.description: How a row's content (ornament, label, image, trailing icon) is spread across the row: `justify-content` on `.sgs-nav-drawer-menu__link`. '' keeps the row's own alignment (start).

submenuCaretSize.description: A CSS length overriding the accordion expander glyph's width/height, which otherwise rides `1em` off the row's own font-size. Empty keeps that default.

submenuCaretGap.description: Gap between a row's label and its expander glyph. Applies to a row that toggles as a whole (a top-level item with no page of its own), where label and expander share one row. In a split row the expander is its own 44px touch target pinned to the row end, so there is no gap to set. Empty keeps the default (0).

submenuCaretOpacity.description: Resting opacity (0 to 1) of the expander glyph, independent of the row's own itemOpacity. No default: unset emits no opacity rule.

submenuCaretOpacityHover.description: Opacity (0 to 1) of the expander glyph while its row's head (label, expander or whole-row toggle) is hovered or keyboard-focused. Touch-guarded. No default: unset emits no rule.

submenuCaretTurnDuration.description: Milliseconds the expander glyph takes to turn while its section opens (the turn angle is itemExpanderRotate). No default: unset keeps the block's own 200ms expander transition.

submenuCaretTurnEasing.description: Easing curve for the expander's turn, from the shared motion easing list. Empty falls back to 'ease' once a turn duration is set.

submenuCaretTurnEasingCustom.description: A hand-typed cubic-bezier() curve, read only when submenuCaretTurnEasing is 'custom'.

submenuAnimation.description: How an accordion section arrives and leaves: none / fade / fade-lift / height. PHP-validated, no JSON enum. Default none keeps today's instant native <details> toggle. `height` collapses and grows the section's height; `fade` and `fade-lift` (8px lift) change opacity only. Accordion mode only: drill-down keeps its own slide. Built on `::details-content` and `interpolate-size`, so a browser without them opens and closes whole. Under reduced motion sections open and close whole. The bar's `slide-down` and `grow` are floating-panel shapes with no inline equivalent and are not offered.

submenuAnimationDuration.description: Opening time of an accordion section, in milliseconds, 0 to 3000.

submenuAnimationEasing.description: Speed curve for a section opening and closing, from the shared motion easing list (includes/helpers-motion-easing.php).

submenuAnimationEasingCustom.description: A cubic-bezier() curve, read only when submenuAnimationEasing is custom. Validated; an invalid curve falls back to ease-out.

submenuExitDuration.description: Closing time of an accordion section, in milliseconds. 0 closes instantly.

submenuItemStagger.description: Delay between each row arriving when an accordion section opens, in milliseconds. 0 turns the stagger off. Accordion mode only.

submenuItemStaggerDistance.description: How far each row travels as it arrives, in pixels. Negative means it falls from above.

submenuItemStaggerDuration.description: Each row's own arrival time in milliseconds. 0 uses the section's opening time.

submenuItemStaggerMax.description: Cap on a row's delay in milliseconds. 0 means no cap.

submenuItemStaggerScope.description: 'columns' (default) staggers a plain section's rows, and a mega section's direct column children. 'rows' staggers every link row/card inside each `sgs/mega-group` column instead (the column itself stops animating so only one granularity moves). A plain link section is unaffected either way, its rows are already the direct children.

submenuBorderRadius.description: The open accordion section's corner radius, the same FLAT corner object shape as itemBorderRadius (topLeft / topRight / bottomRight / bottomLeft, CSS length strings, read by sgs_corner_object_shorthand()). Default EMPTY: the section keeps its square corners.

submenuShadow.description: Box shadow of the open accordion section, composed with submenuShadowColour by sgs_shadow_value_composed(). Empty draws no shadow.

submenuShadowColour.description: The shadow's colour. The name is fixed by ShadowControl.js::shadowAttrKeys, which composes it as <base>Colour.

itemMedia.description: Wave 3C U-7, M-15/M-22 (.claude/reports/2026-09-25-u6-u7-design.md 3f). Per-item media: '' none, `featured-image` shows the linked page's own featured image beside its label (a GIF or WebP is served full size so it keeps animating). Custom links show none.

itemMediaReveal.description: Per tier: `none`, `always`, or `hover` (grows from nothing on hover or keyboard focus of its row).

navColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the nav text with a background-clip:text mechanism instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over navColour. Safe unconditionally -- navBg already paints on a separate ::after layer (sgs_block_background_layer_css()), never this same selector.

itemColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the resting nav-item text with a background-clip:text mechanism instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over itemColour. Safe unconditionally -- itemBg already paints on a ::before layer, never this same selector. See itemColourHoverGradient for the Hover-state sibling.

itemBgGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the resting nav-item background via the same ::before layer as itemBg; non-empty wins over the flat itemBg colour, mirroring itemColourGradient's sibling-wins pattern.

itemColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the Hover-state nav-item text, mirroring itemColourGradient's background-clip:text mechanism. Non-empty wins over itemColourHover. Offered in the editor ONLY while itemSmartContrast is OFF (the default) -- when itemSmartContrast is ON, itemColourHover auto-computes a safe solid colour for WCAG contrast against itemBgHover, which a gradient cannot meaningfully replace, so a stored value here is ignored by render.php while the swap is active rather than silently reappearing.

featuredColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the featured bar item's LABEL-form text with a background-clip:text mechanism instead of a flat colour (mirrors burgerColourGradient). Non-empty wins over featuredColour. Resting LABEL form only (no featuredBg set) -- the PILL form (featuredBg set) keeps its WCAG-contrast-resolved flat foreground, and the submenu inheritance custom property (--sgs-nm-featured-colour) stays flat-only because its consumer paints a background on the same selector (see render.php).

featuredBgGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the featured item's PILL-form background (background-image custom-property-gradient pattern). Non-empty wins over the resolved featuredBg slug/hex. When active, the pill's foreground SKIPS the WCAG contrast-against-background computation (sgs_wcag_preferred_text_colour_for_bg() needs ONE background hex; a gradient has none) and uses the operator's own FLAT featuredColour/featuredColourHover choice instead -- never the gradient-capable text resolve, which would collide with this same background-image on the same selector (see render.php comment at the featured-item paint block, and featuredColourGradient's note above for the identical precedent on the flat-hex pill form). The submenu-inherited featured item (--sgs-nm-featured-bg custom property) is NOT extended to carry this gradient -- same documented scope boundary as featuredColourGradient's submenu gap above.

featuredBgHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the featured item's PILL-form :hover/:focus-visible background (mirrors featuredBgGradient). Non-empty wins over the resolved featuredBgHover slug/hex. Same WCAG-skip rationale as featuredBgGradient: the hover foreground uses the operator's own flat featuredColourHover (falling back to featuredColour) rather than computing WCAG contrast against a gradient.

submenuPadding.description: FR-2b — DRAWER-specific non-zero default. The bar block (sgs/nav-bar-menu) keeps {} (0), matching the dropdown panel's own floating-panel padding; this block's accordion rows need real breathing room since they render inline in the drawer's flow rather than inside a floating panel. The shared emitter (sgs_emit_responsive_css()) overrides nav-menu-submenu-css.php's hardcoded padding:0 fallback the moment a value is set. Value matches both Claude Design nested-drawer references (bottom-heavy '0 0 16px' / '0 6px 16px' shape).

itemBgCurrentGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the current-page nav item's background via the same ::before layer as itemBg; non-empty wins over the flat itemBgCurrent colour.

itemBgHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the hovered nav item's background via the same ::before layer as itemBg; non-empty wins over the flat itemBgHover colour. It completes the row's three-state gradient set (itemBgGradient / this / itemBgCurrentGradient) and is what the Highlight treatment paints with when the operator picks a gradient (Spec 41 FR-41-25).

itemFontWeightCurrent.description: The non-colour current-page signal (Spec 41 FR-41-6), so the state is distinguishable without relying on colour alone. String, not number — matches itemFontWeight.

itemFontWeightHover.description: String, not number — matches itemFontWeight and itemFontWeightCurrent. A weight change on hover can reflow the bar; the control's help text carries that caution.

itemSmartContrast.description: Opt-in AUTO-FIX: when ON, resolves the item's foreground automatically so it stays readable against whatever background the item is sitting on (Spec 41 FR-41-5). Default OFF: an operator's explicit itemColourHover is respected as-authored — no silent swap. The readability CHECK itself is unconditional and always warns in the editor inspector regardless of this setting; only the automatic colour SWAP is gated on it.

itemBorderWidth.description: Default is OFF (empty object, no border painted) until the operator sets a width. On a vertical list (this block, rendered inside a nav-drawer, or a submenu-root stacked in-drawer) the bottom edge is geometrically a ROW SEPARATOR between two adjacent rows; on the horizontal bar (sgs/nav-bar-menu's copy of this attribute family) the identical bottom edge is the ITEM UNDERLINE. See nav-menu-css.php's item-border comment for the full reasoning. Not to be confused with `separators`, the independent line between top-level rows (FR-41-37).

itemBorderRadius.description: A FLAT corner object of CSS length STRINGS, read by sgs_corner_object_shorthand(), which looks for exactly topLeft / topRight / bottomRight / bottomLeft. NOT the {"desktop":{}} tier envelope — that shape belongs to BLOCK-ROOT radii read by sgs_border_radius_tiers(); used here it would carry no corner keys, the helper would return null, and the radius would silently vanish. Per-element precedent: sgs/product-card::ctaBorderRadius.

itemBorderColour.description: FR-41-36 locked default: underline/row-separator colour at rest (bar: item underline; drawer: row separator — see itemBorderWidth's note).

itemBorderColourHover.description: FR-41-36 locked default: underline/row-separator colour on hover.

itemBorderColourCurrent.description: FR-41-36 locked default: underline/row-separator colour on current/active — same colour as Hover; the absence of a bg fill is what distinguishes Current from Hover.

itemColourHoverTreatment.description: How the item TEXT colour changes on hover: none / swap / sweep. The Sweep option is offered and emitted only when supports.sgs.sweepEligibility.itemColourHoverTreatment passes (Spec 41 FR-41-26). PHP-validated, no JSON enum.

itemBgHoverTreatment.description: How the item BACKGROUND changes on hover: none / swap / highlight. 'highlight' renders the sliding pill, painting from itemBgHover / itemBgHoverGradient (Spec 41 FR-41-25). PHP-validated, no JSON enum.

itemBorderHoverTreatment.description: How the item BORDER colour changes on hover: none / swap / sweep. PHP-validated, no JSON enum.

itemOpacity.description: M-21. Resting opacity (0 to 1) of the top-level item link (and its paired caret glyph). No default — unset emits no opacity rule at all (fully opaque, matching every instance shipped before this attribute existed). Reference: fantasy's top-level items rest at full opacity (unset).

itemOpacityHover.description: M-21. Hover/focus-visible opacity (0 to 1) of the top-level item link (and its paired caret glyph), touch-guarded via sgs_hover_state_rules(). No default — unset emits no rule. Reference: buck/fantasy fade the hovered top-level item to 0.5 (1 to 0.5). Submenu/sublink opacity (fantasy's separate 0.6-to-1 rest/hover pair on `a.menu-sub-link`) is a GENUINELY DIFFERENT value from the top-level item's own opacity on the same reference — reusing this attribute on the sublink would apply the wrong number, so it is scoped to the item element only; see submenuOpacity/submenuOpacityHover below for the sublink's own pair.

itemPaddingShiftHover.description: M-21. On hover/focus, the item's own inline-start padding GROWS by this length: padding-inline-start:calc(<resting inline-start padding> + <value>). Applies to the top-level item link (style.css base 12px) and the accordion's nested submenu link (nav-menu-submenu-css.php base 16px, the same shared emitter the bar's dropdown uses) -- both read their own resting literal since neither exposes it as a single attribute. Validated through sgs_css_single_length_value(). Empty emits no shift. A per-site value, set alongside the item's own padding.

submenuOpacity.description: M-21. Resting opacity (0 to 1) of the accordion's nested submenu link (`.{bem}__sublink`), the same shared emitter (nav-menu-submenu-css.php) the bar's dropdown uses. No default — unset emits no opacity rule at all. Reference: fantasy's submenu links rest at 0.6 — the OPPOSITE direction from the top-level item's own itemOpacity/itemOpacityHover pair, which is why this is a separate attribute rather than a reuse of that one.

submenuOpacityHover.description: M-21. Hover/focus-visible opacity (0 to 1) of the accordion's nested submenu link, touch-guarded via sgs_hover_state_rules(). No default — unset emits no rule. Reference: fantasy's submenu links brighten to full opacity (1) on hover, from a 0.6 rest — closing the M-21 exit cell the item pair alone could not cover.

sweepAngle.description: Directional sweep angle (FR-41-37) -- standard CSS gradient-angle degrees (0=to top, 90=to right, 180=to bottom, 270=to left), the same convention @wordpress/components's AnglePickerControl uses. Governs the item border/underline Sweep (itemBorderHoverTreatment==='sweep'). Default 90 sweeps left-to-right; 270 sweeps right-to-left. See includes/sweep-css.php.

submenuColourCurrent.description: Current-page ('you are here') submenu row text colour. Defaults to the `text` token: `text` against `submenuLinkBgCurrent`'s `surface-alt` default measures 14.31:1 on the framework's default palette (WCAG AA, verified via wcag-contrast.js maths). A fixed default token, not a runtime contrast computation, so the default does not depend on a contrast-check mechanism.

submenuLinkBg.description: Normal-state submenu row background. Defaults to the palette's cream `surface` token: an explicit, deterministic opaque background means the row always paints its own surface regardless of what colour the surrounding drawer uses, so no runtime drawerBg-aware contrast computation is needed. `text` on `surface` measures 11.86:1 (WCAG AA). Shared by both the bar's dropdown panel and the drawer's nested/accordion submenu (one attribute family, FR-41-36).

submenuLinkBgHover.description: Hover-state submenu row background. Defaults to the brand's `primary` fill. `submenuColourHover` default-closes to `text` at the PHP layer (nav-menu-submenu-css.php), which measures 5.28:1 against this `primary` fill (WCAG AA) — a clear, on-brand hover signal distinct from both the cream Normal state and the Current state.

submenuLinkBgCurrent.description: Current-page ('you are here') submenu row background. Defaults to `surface-alt`, a real framework token every theme.json defines — a subtly raised/alt surface, the same convention a 'currently selected row' uses in an ordinary list. Visually distinct from both the cream Normal row (`surface`) and the solid `primary` Hover fill, while staying closer in tone to Normal than Hover — the standard 'you are here, but not being pointed at' affordance. Paired with `submenuColourCurrent`'s `text` default: 14.31:1 on the framework's default palette (WCAG AA, verified via wcag-contrast.js maths).

submenuLinkBgGradient.description: Normal-state gradient sibling of submenuLinkBg; non-empty wins over the flat colour.

submenuColourHoverTreatment.description: How the submenu LINK text colour changes on hover: none / swap / sweep. Sweep is offered and emitted only when supports.sgs.sweepEligibility.submenuColourHoverTreatment passes. PHP-validated, no JSON enum.

submenuLinkBgHoverTreatment.description: How the submenu LINK background changes on hover: none / swap. Two options only — there is no Highlight on this row. PHP-validated, no JSON enum.

submenuBorderColourGradient.description: Normal-state gradient sibling of submenuBorderColour; non-empty wins over the flat colour.

submenuFontSize.description: A {desktop,tablet,mobile} TIER OBJECT, mirroring itemFontSize. There are deliberately no submenuFontSizeTablet / submenuFontSizeMobile siblings: TypographyControls and sgs_typography_css_rule() both branch on whether the stored value is an object and keep all three tiers inside this one attribute, so flat tier keys would have zero writers and zero readers.

sublinkMarkerColour.description: FR-41-30(b): unset, the marker inherits currentColor from the sublink's own text. The inspector shows this row (and its Hover/Current/gradient siblings below) only once sublinkMarkerIcon differs from its declared default -- render.php itself carries no such gate, since an unset value already paints nothing.

itemPadding.description: 4-side box-object family (box_family 'itemPadding'), a {desktop,tablet,mobile} tier object of {top,right,bottom,left}. Padding inside each top-level menu link. Empty keeps the default 8px 12px; the left side is also what itemPaddingShiftHover adds to. Same attribute name as sgs/nav-bar-menu's own itemPadding (2026-09-28 — the bar and drawer menus were one block; every item-level control belongs on both).

submenuLinkPadding.description: 4-side box-object family (box_family 'submenuLinkPadding'), a {desktop,tablet,mobile} tier object of {top,right,bottom,left}. Padding inside each submenu/accordion link (dropdown, mega fallback list, drawer accordion). Empty keeps the default 0 16px inline-start; the inline-start side is also what itemPaddingShiftHover adds to. New 2026-09-28 (Spec 36 'Item hover paint' M-21) — replaces the previously-hardcoded padding:0 16px literal in includes/nav-menu-submenu-css.php.

megaBodyPadding.description: 4-side box-object family (box_family 'megaBodyPadding'), a {desktop,tablet,mobile} tier object of {top,right,bottom,left}. Padding around a mega item's panel inside its drawer accordion (.sgs-nav-drawer-menu__mega-body). Empty keeps the default 0 12px 12px.

itemColourOpen.description: The label colour of a top-level accordion item WHILE ITS OWN SECTION IS EXPANDED (G-11, 2026-09-28) — a fourth colour state distinct from Normal/Hover/Current: Current is page-identity (aria-current), this is disclosure-state (the <details> element's own [open] attribute). Declared as its own element ('item-open'), not a state on 'item', for the same reason 'disabled' is its own element — 'open' is not in golden-controls.json's stateVocabulary (hover/current/scrolled). Unset paints nothing (inherits Normal).

itemOrnamentRevealMode.description: G-6 (2026-09-28), a {desktop,tablet,mobile} tier object: 'static' (default — the ornament shows however itemOrnament says, no reveal effect) or 'hover-draw' (the ornament stays hidden at rest and draws its SVG strokes in sequence, stroke-dashoffset per path, staggered, on hover/focus; touch-guarded via sgs_hover_state_rules(), instant under prefers-reduced-motion). Only meaningful when itemOrnament is 'icon' at that tier — an 'index' (counter) ornament has no strokes to draw.

itemOrnamentReserveSpace.description: G-6 (2026-09-28). When itemOrnamentRevealMode is 'hover-draw', the ornament is invisible at rest; this keeps its layout box (width + gap) reserved at rest too, so the label text does not shift indent when the ornament draws in on hover. Off by default (the ornament's box collapses at rest, matching itemOrnament's own resting behaviour).

itemOrnamentFrames.description: Ornament frame sequence: an ordered list of alternate glyph frames, each a custom SVG ({source:'custom', svg}, re-sanitised server-side with sgs_svg_kses_allowed_tags(), at most 8). On row hover or keyboard focus they flash in order, one slot each, before the ornament settles on its resting (or hover) glyph. Pure CSS (includes/nav-drawer-menu-ornament-frames.php); frames are aria-hidden and prefers-reduced-motion shows only the final glyph. Empty (default) renders exactly as before. Icon ornaments only.

itemOrnamentFrameDuration.description: Per tier ({desktop,tablet,mobile}), the milliseconds each ornament frame is shown (10 to 1000). Unset is 60.

itemOrnamentFramePlay.description: Per tier ({desktop,tablet,mobile}), 'on' or 'off': whether the ornament frame sequence plays at that device size. Unset is on (when itemOrnamentFrames has frames).

itemTrailingIcons.description: G-7 (2026-09-28) — a per-item map, { [item identifier]: { source, name } | { source: 'custom', svg } }, same identifier scheme as featuredItemIds/disabledItemIds. A trailing glyph after ANY row's label (leaf items and accordion-parent rows), independent of the accordion expander (itemExpanderIcon, which only appears on rows that already have a submenu). 'custom' is a client-supplied, server-re-sanitised inline SVG (sgs_svg_kses_allowed_tags()) — the IconPicker's own client-side sanitiser is a second enforcement layer, never the only one.

itemTrailingIconColour.description: G-7. Colour of every row's trailing icon (block-level, one colour for all — the icon CHOICE is per-item via itemTrailingIcons, matching itemBadgeColour's block-level-colour/per-item-copy split). Unset inherits currentColor from the row's own text.

itemTrailingIconSize.description: G-7. Per-tier icon box size ({desktop,tablet,mobile}), same shape as itemOrnamentSize. Empty keeps the 10px default.

itemBadgeColour.description: Parity with sgs/nav-bar-menu (2026-09-28) — background of the optional per-item badge chip ("SOON", "NEW"). Block-level: one colour applies to every badge this drawer renders. Badge COPY itself is per-item (the operator's WordPress menu-item Description field, repurposed — includes/nav-menu-markup.php::sgs_nav_shared_badge_html(), already called from this block's render path). Token slug or hex, same shape as sgs/cart's badgeColour.

itemBadgeTextColour.description: Parity with sgs/nav-bar-menu (2026-09-28) — text colour of the optional per-item badge chip. See itemBadgeColour.

itemMinHeight.description: Top-level link height floor per device (CSS length). Empty keeps the 44px touch-target default. Emitted by includes/nav-menu-item-padding-css.php::sgs_nav_item_padding_css(), shared with the other nav menu block.

itemBadgePadding.description: Badge chip padding, a {desktop,tablet,mobile} tier object of {top,right,bottom,left}. Empty keeps the stylesheet's em-based default.

itemBadgeBorderRadius.description: Badge chip corner radius (CSS length). Empty keeps the stylesheet default.

itemBadgeGap.description: Space between an item's label and its badge (CSS length). Empty keeps the stylesheet's em-based default.

disabledItemIds.description: Parity with sgs/nav-bar-menu (2026-09-28) — item identifiers (same scheme as featuredItemIds) rendered as non-interactive, non-focusable text instead of a link. Ticked in the Settings tab's Disabled items panel. Wired for accordion-parent rows (sgs_nav_drawer_menu_accordion_html()); leaf/sub-item rows render through the shared includes/nav-menu-markup.php::sgs_nav_drawer_menu_render_items(), out of this block's file-ownership scope for this pass — see that function's own docblock note.

itemDisabledColour.description: Parity with sgs/nav-bar-menu (2026-09-28) — text colour of a disabled item/sublink. Token slug or hex.
